summary:
Iteration 9: verified dashboard search + page-size + pagination, listmirror-style iframe embed modal, /embed/ route alias, and admin-managed ad slots (header/footer/player top+bottom). Backend pytest: 35/35 pass, including new TestAdSettings (GET /api/settings has 4 ad_* keys default empty string; admin PUT persists ad_header/footer/player_top/player_bottom then reset works). Frontend Playwright: admin login OK (redirects to /admin - existing behavior); /dashboard shows data-testid='mirror-search-input' + page-size select with options exactly ['25','50','100']; with 2 seeded mirrors pagination bar correctly hidden. Search 'zzz_nonexistent_xyz' shows data-testid='no-results'; search 'SMioOAxb' filters to 1 row. Embed modal opens on data-testid='embed-code-' and contains direct link 'https://.../embed/-B7RoZcD' plus iframe textarea with EXACT format '' and copy-embed-code-button. /embed/SMioOAxb route alias loads the public player with VOE + DoodStream host tabs. Admin 'Werbung' tab (data-testid='admin-tab-ads') exposes all 4 setting-ad_* textareas + save-ads-button; saving ad_header='
MY AD
' renders on landing (data-testid='ad-header' innerHTML contains injected div and live-ad-header rendered), saving ad_player_top renders inside /embed/SMioOAxb (data-testid='ad-player-top' + live-ad-player-top present). CLEANUP: all 4 ad_* settings reset to empty via PUT /api/admin/settings and verified via GET /api/settings; live-ad-header no longer present on landing. Seeded mirrors SMioOAxb + -B7RoZcD preserved. Regressions all pass (i18n DE default, host tabs render, geo ordering ES=VOE first at 12.0 / US=VOE first at 40.0, DoodStream canonical dsvplay.com, VOE rotating direct domain, thumbnails on doimg.net, admin login).
critical_code_review_comments: AdSlot injects arbitrary HTML via innerHTML and re-executes <script> tags. This is by design for ad networks, but any admin-visible XSS vector (e.g., a compromised admin session) becomes site-wide arbitrary code execution on the public landing and every /embed/<slug> page. Consider (a) a CSP that only permits known ad network origins, (b) a warning/confirmation dialog when saving ad_* with <script> tags, and (c) treating these settings as admin-only forever (currently correct - PUT /api/admin/settings is admin-gated).

Dashboard.jsx builds the embed iframe using window.location.origin. On self-hosted deployments behind reverse proxies where origin differs from public URL, the snippet may embed the wrong host. Consider using REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (or a configurable public_url from settings) as the canonical origin.
Pagination hides when total<=pageSize which is correct, but there is no aria-label / role='navigation' on the pagination container - low-cost a11y improvement.

SettingsInput requires site_name (no default) - admin PUT with only ad_* fields will 422. UI always includes site_name so this is fine, but the API contract is coupled; consider a dedicated /api/admin/settings/ads PATCH endpoint or making all fields optional with server-side merge.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - search/pagination/page-size, embed modal iframe format, /embed/<slug> route, admin ads tab, and live rendering + cleanup all verified

seed_data_creation: None new. Seeded mirrors SMioOAxb and -B7RoZcD preserved. All 4 ad_* settings reset to empty after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 additions: (a) Dashboard search (data-testid=mirror-search-input filters by title/slug via useMemo), page-size select (values 25/50/100), pagination bar (data-testid=pagination with page-prev, page-next, page-N buttons) hidden when total <= pageSize, and data-testid=no-results shown for empty filter result. (b) Embed modal (data-testid=embed-code-modal) opened by data-testid=embed-code-<id> exposes embed-direct-link (readonly input ending in /embed/<slug>) and embed-iframe-code (textarea) with EXACT format <iframe src="<origin>/embed/<slug>" width="100%" height="520" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>, plus copy-embed-code-button. (c) /embed/<slug> route alias added to App.js (both /e/<slug> and /embed/<slug> render EmbedPlayer). (d) AdminDashboard 'Werbung' tab (data-testid=admin-tab-ads) with 4 textareas setting-ad_header / setting-ad_footer / setting-ad_player_top / setting-ad_player_bottom and save-ads-button; AdSlot component renders raw HTML (innerHTML + script re-exec) into data-testid ad-header/ad-footer/ad-player-top/ad-player-bottom on LandingPage / EmbedPlayer. Backend: SettingsInput + DEFAULT_SETTINGS include ad_* fields (default ''), get_settings merges defaults so keys always present. Note: admin login redirects to /admin not /dashboard - navigate explicitly to /dashboard when testing dashboard features.
